_comment: PAPER ONLY lean trader config (python -m lean --config). Every key the runner reads is listed; unknown keys are refused. strategy_config is relative to this file. initial_cash_sol creates a NEW store; an existing store must match it. LINT1/LINT2/LINT4: every merged feature is ON at paper-collection defaults (L07R paths, L10 execution, L11 held_risk, L14 watchlist, L15 ops, L16 route_check, L12F features, L13 wallet_signals, L20 sell_evidence (flag_only) + flow, L21 risk_external, L22 honeypot_sim, L23 bot_exit (shadow), L24 clusters). features, wallet_signals, flow, clusters, bot_exit and risk_external are RECORDING ONLY (never read by the strategy) and run in their own threads (run mode only) on the shared Helius LOW lane (risk_external: its own RugCheck bucket); sell_evidence probes the low lane inside the L10 exit delay and, under flag_only, never changes a fill. honeypot_sim is the ONE new entry filter (MAIN lane, unsigned simulateTransaction only). route_check (L16) re-uses the quote response: no extra provider call, never signs or sends. watchlist (L14): soft rejects (incl. ENTRY_THROTTLE) are re-screened on the MAIN lane after the fresh scan, portfolio-blocked mints cost nothing, hard cap watch_max_rescreens_per_hour (<= 360 Helius + 240 Jupiter calls/h), watch_hours must be <= screen.max_age_seconds. held_risk (L11) probes and account checks run on the shared LOW lane after the exits.

lanes._comment: L07R/LINT4: helius_rps is the Helius plan rate the process may use (Developer plan = 50 RPS; absent = 10/s as before; burst = rate). main/exit/low are shares of each provider's rate and must sum to <= 1: Helius 20/s -> main 7, exit 4, low 9 req/s; Jupiter keeps its 4/s -> 1.4 / 0.8 / 1.8. The low lane never waits and is shed for low_shed_s after any 429 (and by ops while over the credit budget).

paths._comment: L07R price-path recorder (low lane, run mode only): every hazard-free candidate, entered or not, is marked every interval_s for path_hours into its OWN db (null = <state-dir>/paths.sqlite; never lean.sqlite). Past max_db_gb the file rolls over to paths-YYYYMMDD.sqlite; below min_free_gb of free disk nothing is written.

execution._comment: L10: every BUY/SELL re-quoted exec_delay_s later (BUY at the worse of q0/q1, SELL at q1; exits are two-phase, ONE delay per pass); fees include priority fee + Jito tip per tx, ATA rent (refunded on a full close) and the Token-2022 transfer fee. exec_delay_s must be <= price_ttl_seconds - 2.

ops._comment: L15: credit tracker (counts every lane at the transport; costs are ESTIMATES: calibrate against the Helius dashboard), systemd watchdog, regime log. LINT4: Helius Developer plan = 10,000,000 credits/month; the budget is 90 % of it. Standard RPC 1 credit, getProgramAccounts and DAS getAsset 10, getTransactionsForAddress 100 (unused today); RugCheck 0. Over budget the shared Helius low lane is shed (paths, features, wallet_signals, flow, sell_evidence, bot_exit, clusters); screening, honeypot_sim and exits never are.

features._comment: L12F entry feature capture: one observations(kind='features') row per screened candidate (a small row in lean.sqlite), <= 3 extra Helius calls per hazard-free candidate on the shared low lane (dev balance, pool signatures, holders of a soft reject); hazard rejects cost nothing. Absent = off; enrich=false writes only the free fields. LINT2b: nothing after the decision is counted (decision_ts, late_s, flags in every row); a no_token shed is retried every 0.5 s for up to shed_wait_s; the dev balance / soft-reject holders are snapshots read at collection and not read at all when the row is later than max_late_s after the decision.

wallet_signals._comment: L13 bundle/sniper + smart-wallet signal (this object turns it on; null/absent = off). Every screened candidate, ~125 s after graduation: <= max_calls Helius calls on the shared low lane (2 signature pages + supply + 6 txs + 3 x 2 funding). Smart-wallet outcomes come from the L07R2 paths.sqlite (read-only) or the desk's own closed trades. retain_raw none keeps the 1000-row signature pages (~170 KB each) out of lean.sqlite; backfill_max_age_s 1800 (by graduation time) bounds the catch-up after a restart. LINT2b: the swap window ends at the screen decision (window_s must stay <= screen.min_age_seconds or every row flags window_cut_by_decision); smart_buyers_count uses only outcomes resolved before the decision; a funder of buyers of >= hub_min_mints mints in hub_window_s is a detected hub, never a cluster; calls only while reserve_tokens more tokens stay for the path recorder / L11 / L12F, paced at 0.5 s.

sell_evidence._comment: L20 paper realism: before a paper SELL is booked, the pool must show >= min_organic_sells successful sells by DISTINCT signers (not the coin creator, not the paper taker) in the last sell_window_s. One getSignaturesForAddress + <= max_tx_samples getTransaction on the shared LOW lane, run on a daemon thread INSIDE the L10 exit delay (needs execution; an exit is never later than without it). VERIFIED: booked normally. UNVERIFIED (the probe completed and found too few): booked as SELL_UNVERIFIED, valued at 0 proceeds under policy zero (paper.write_off of the same qty), or at the quote and flagged under flag_only. Shed / failed / not finished in time: booked normally, sell_evidence UNKNOWN. LINT4: the example ships flag_only (under zero a quiet pool would value a legitimate stop at 0 and distort the data; real honeypots are blocked at entry by L22 honeypot_sim). Conclusive results cached per pool for cache_s; hard cap max_calls_per_hour. Absent / enabled false = off.

flow._comment: L20 order-flow / bot-pump features (FEATURES ONLY, never read by the strategy): one observations(kind='flow') row per screen PASS decision with tx_rate_per_s, buy_sell_ratio, unique_buyers/sellers, trade_size_cv, monotonic_up_frac, max_drawdown_pre over the window_s BEFORE the decision (block_time + 1 <= decision_ts; decision_ts / late_s / flags like L12F v3). <= sig_pages + max_txs Helius calls per decision on the shared LOW lane (own thread, paced, leaves reserve_tokens for the other low-lane users), hard cap max_calls_per_hour. Absent / enabled false = off.

honeypot_sim._comment: L22 honeypot sell-simulation ENTRY FILTER (absent = off). Token-2022 / extension / live-authority mints and non-pump sources only: a plain pump-graduated SPL mint with revoked authorities is recorded SKIPPED_STANDARD_SPL with no call. A real top holder (pool vault, burn and creator excluded) is asked to SELL via Jupiter swap/v2/build (taker = holder) and the UNSIGNED transaction goes to Helius simulateTransaction (sigVerify false, replaceRecentBlockhash true): never signed, never sent. MAIN lane, before the entry quotes; at most max_per_hour simulated candidates (<= 5 Helius + 3 Jupiter calls each). SELL_SIM_BLOCKED = hazard reject HONEYPOT_SIM_BLOCKED; INCONCLUSIVE/NO_BUILD rejects only a Token-2022 mint with a transfer hook or a transfer fee > 10%. full_size also simulates our full paper size when the holder holds it.

bot_exit._comment: L23 bot-exit detection on held positions, SHADOW ONLY: records decisions(kind='shadow_exit') with the metrics and a hypothetical exit value; trading is NOT changed. mode "live" would exit through the normal two-phase path with reason BOT_EXIT: keep it shadow until the report shows the signals save money. Own thread, shared LOW lane, <= max_calls_per_pass Helius calls every poll_s (1 getSignaturesForAddress per position + sampled getTransaction + getTokenLargestAccounts every holders_every polls), paced pace_s, leaving reserve_tokens; a shed ends the pass. rules: a signal when every condition of any rule holds; a metric without enough evidence never holds.

clusters._comment: L24 linked-wallet clusters (this object turns it on; null/absent = off). RECORDING ONLY, never read by the strategy. Per screened candidate, as of its decision: a graph over the top-20 holders (the screen's own snapshot), the early buyers (L13) and the creator, linked by shared non-hub funders (L13's map + bounded lookups), direct SOL/token transfers, same-slot first buys, Jito bundles (adjacent same-slot pool signatures with a tip) and same-transaction co-signers; connected components -> cluster_count, largest_cluster_supply_pct, top_cluster_holders, creator_cluster_supply_pct, linked_supply_pct_total, jito_bundled_buys, fresh_wallet_share. <= max_calls Helius calls per candidate on the shared low lane (2 pool pages + owners + 4 window txs + 6 x (history page + funding tx)), only while reserve_tokens more tokens stay for the path recorder / L11 / L12F / L13, paced at 0.5 s, on its own thread; it waits up to signals_wait_s for L13's row.

risk_external._comment: L21 external risk rows (RECORDING ONLY, never read by the strategy; absent/null = off): one observations(kind='risk_external') row per hazard-free screened candidate from the public RugCheck report (GET api.rugcheck.xyz/v1/tokens/<mint>/report, no key): score, risks, holders, insider networks, top-10 (AMM excluded), LP locked, rugged; the creator's other tokens in the 7/30 days before the decision (dead = marketCap < dead_mcap_usd) with rugged read from the newest creator_sample (<= 3) of them; copycat name/symbol/image matches against the tokens collected in the last copycat_window_s. Own RugCheck bucket (rate_per_s, never a Helius/Jupiter lane), own daemon thread, handed over right after the screen decision; ~1-4 calls per candidate (~70-280 calls/h at 70 candidates/h). Every value is flagged AT_COLLECTION; the learner uses it only when late_s <= its max_late_s. A 429 stops all calls for max(backoff_s, Retry-After). Raw bodies up to raw_max_bytes are kept as observations(kind='risk_external:rugcheck').

curves._comment: C2 bonding-curve recorder (recording only; low lane; own curves.sqlite). OFF here: the V2 call (getProgramAccountsV2 + changedSinceSlot) must be verified live first. getProgramAccounts costs ~10 credits per call; max_credits_month (500k) becomes a rolling-hour budget and stretches poll_s to ~52 s. method: getProgramAccounts (one huge response, small clusters/fakes only) or getProgramAccountsV2.
